Olive-brown uniform, two ochre/gold collar patches and the small dark central neckwear opening remain; the collar fits a rounded chin through a short broad transition with no long stalk, pinching or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque light muted backplate, overlapping cream note with compact upper marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small right-edge tab are retained. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte halo.

entries.visible_limitations: Exact collar-patch symbols and the small central neckwear detail are too small to classify at 65x67; no additional insignia or broad facial hair was invented. Note marks remain indistinct visual groups, not newly readable text.
